nl_question: 统计 zs_POI_dm 表总记录数
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM zs_POI_dm;

nl_question: 查询名称包含'酒店'的前20条POI
sql_query: SELECT MC,DZ FROM zs_POI_dm WHERE MC LIKE '%酒店%' LIMIT 20;

nl_question: 查询每个POI对应的标准地址编码
sql_query: SELECT p.GUID,p.BZ_GUID FROM zs_POI_dm p WHERE p.BZ_GUID IS NOT NULL;

nl_question: 统计各大类 POI 数量
sql_query: SELECT DLMC,COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM zs_POI_dm GROUP BY DLMC ORDER BY cnt DESC;
sparql_or_graph_query: SELECT ?dlmc (COUNT(?s) AS ?cnt) WHERE { ?s <zs_POI_dm.DLMC> ?dlmc . } GROUP BY ?dlmc ORDER BY DESC(?cnt)

nl_question: 找出地址在'中山市'且有联系方式的POI
sql_query: SELECT MC,DZ,LXFS FROM zs_POI_dm WHERE DZ LIKE '%中山市%' AND LXFS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(LXFS) <> '';
